To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a distributed data warehouse is a distributed database that contains a data warehouse and (2) a data warehouse is a database containing a set of relations that are derived from a collection of source databases and that is designed for decision support.

a distributed data warehouse can be designed by applying a methodology that is similar to that of a distributed database system, and that the data warehouse fact relation can be fragmented horizontally by using a fragmentation algorithm.
a distributed data warehouse architecture can be designed by using a methodology that is similar to the methodology used in designing centralized data warehouses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a methodology for designing distributed data warehouses.
the design of distributed data warehouses.
the development of a methodology for the design and implementation of distributed data warehouses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this research has provided an architectural model for the design and implementation of a distributed data warehouse environment, the formal definition for the fact relation in the relational data model, and a methodology for the distribution of a fact relation in a data warehouse environment.
this research has provided a foundation for future research and development in distributed data warehousing.

the distributed data warehouse is an effective solution to the problem of data integration in large corporations and that the methodology presented here provides a systematic and efficient way for the design of distributed data warehouses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data warehouse is a special case of the relational data warehouse and that the data warehouse environment is a natural environment for distribution.
we have developed an architecture for a distributed data warehousing system that is based on a client-server model and we have developed a methodology for designing distributed data warehouses.

a distributed data warehouse can provide a more flexible and efficient data management environment than the centralized data warehouse, but that a distributed data warehousing system requires careful design and implementation.

it provides a framework for the design, development, and implementation of a data warehouse system that is distributed in nature and is based on the relational data model.
a distributed data warehouse can be built with the same functionality as the centralized data warehouse. However, it can provide better performance, better availability, better scalability,
